answer: Each agent’s EigenTrust score is computed from normalized, reciprocity-weighted endorsements and their transitive paths, then discounted by exponential temporal decay with a fixed half-life. A new identity starts with negligible trusted incoming mass, so its eigenvector centrality remains near zero; splitting influence across fresh accounts cannot manufacture history or satisfy consensus thresholds. Sustained honest service is needed to accumulate durable support—whether named marble, willow, or sonnet.
